description: Detect complete multi-parameter operating platforms before applying the frozen four-phase segmenter.
rules: The original excavation-state field is supporting evidence, not a hard platform boundary.
A platform core requires at least two smoothed parameters above their activity floors.
Short internal inactivity gaps may be bridged only inside one continuity block.
Hard sampling gaps always split platforms.
Each retained platform is expanded through adjacent supported activity to include startup and decline context.
The frozen four-phase thresholds are reused after experimental platform detection; frozen outputs are not modified.
